notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Hi guys. I tried to release the update version 1.3 for the game. In this update, based on your requests, I have added a difficulty settings to the game, and now when you start a new game, you can choose between Easy, Normal and Hard difficulty. Also 2 new Achievements and the Brazilian subtitles has been added to the game. 

Please let me know if there's anything you think needs to be added to the game so that I can add them in future updates. Thank you again for support my new game! 🙏



Difficulty settings added (Easy + Normal + Hard)

2 New Achievements added

Brazilian subtitles added

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content: Hi guys! I hope you're doing well. I noticed some of you were having trouble defeating the bosses, so I tried to make them a bit easier (not too much ːsteammockingː) Also, you can easily bind your preferred keys for movement in the game's settings. Thank you for supporting my game!
